rugs.ai_description: This rug features a traditional Persian design with an intricate medallion center and detailed floral motifs in a rich combination of red, navy, and ivory colors. The craftsmanship suggests it may be an antique Kashan piece.
This rug features an intricate floral motif with a cream background accented by blue and rust details. The design is typical of traditional Persian Kashan rugs.
This is an intricate antique Persian Tabriz rug featuring a pictorial design with detailed floral and bird motifs. It is rich in vibrant colors and showcases traditional craftsmanship.
This is an antique Persian Kerman rug, featuring a central medallion design with intricate floral motifs. The palette includes shades of red, ivory, and navy, creating a classic traditional look.
This is an antique Persian Sultanabad rug featuring a complex all-over floral motif with medallion elements and intricate borders. The colors include brown, navy, and ivory.
This is an antique Persian Tabriz rug featuring an intricate floral motif with a medallion center. It displays a traditional aesthetic with rich hues.
This is an antique Persian Bakhtiari rug featuring a striking medallion center and intricate tribal and floral designs. The primary colors are red, navy, and ivory, creating a rich, traditional look.
This is an antique Persian pictorial rug featuring vibrant red, gold, and black colors. It showcases detailed narrative scenes with figures and animals, framed by an ornate floral border.

This is an intricate Persian Isfahan rug featuring a medallion center with detailed floral motifs. The rug displays a rich palette of ivory, gold, and muted earth tones, emphasizing its classic elegance.

This is an intricately designed Persian Isfahan rug featuring pictorial elements and floral motifs in a compartmentalized pattern. The pastel palette includes shades of blue, pink, and cream, adding to its decorative appeal.

This is a contemporary Persian pictorial rug featuring portraits and intricate calligraphy on a rich, decorative background. Its unique design is complemented by a combination of red, ivory, and brown tones.

This is an antique Persian Heriz rug featuring a central medallion design surrounded by floral motifs and a rich color palette. The wear and structure suggest its well-preserved vintage nature, making it a valuable collectible.
This hand-knotted Persian Kashan rug features a central medallion design with intricate floral motifs. Dominated by navy, coral, and cream hues, it exudes a traditional and elegant aesthetic.

This is a vintage Persian Hamadan rug featuring an intricate all-over geometric design with a decorative border. The primary colors are navy, rust, and green, contributing to its traditional aesthetic.
This is a Persian Sultanabad rug featuring rich red and ivory tones with traditional floral motifs. Its elaborate design and color palette suggest it is an antique piece.

This antique Persian Bakhtiari rug features a navy field with brick red and blue floral motifs within an intricate geometric design. Its meticulously detailed borders enhance its traditional elegance.
An elegant antique Persian Sultanabad rug featuring a floral motif and muted colors. Its intricate design and classic aesthetic make it suitable for traditional interiors.
This rug features a traditional Sultanabad design with intricate floral motifs and vibrant colors. The blend of blue and red hues creates a rich, decorative aesthetic.
This is a vintage Persian Bakhtiari rug featuring a distinctive garden panel design. The rug showcases a variety of colors including gold, rust, ivory, blue, and cream in a structured layout.

The rug showcases a robust floral motif on a deep navy field with intricate borders, typical of antique Persian Bidjar designs. Its vivid reds and greens highlight the craftsmanship and traditional aesthetic.
An antique Caucasian Karabagh rug featuring a medallion center with intricate geometric and floral motifs. The rug displays a harmonious blend of navy, cream, and rust colors with detailed borders.
This is a Persian Bidjar rug featuring a central medallion pattern with floral motifs and a detailed floral border. Its rich red and navy tones are combined with ivory highlights.

This is an antique Persian Heriz rug featuring a complex geometric and floral design with a rich color palette. Notably, it blends traditional motifs with a bold medallion on a richly patterned field.
This rug features a classic Heriz design with a central medallion and rich geometric patterns. The primary colors are red, navy, and ivory, creating a bold traditional look.
This is an antique Persian Bakhtiari rug featuring a bold medallion design with floral motifs and a rich color palette of red, navy, and ivory. The intricate borders add to its traditional appeal.
